mapper.sql: cp.id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.slug, ''), CONCAT('post-', cp.id)) AS slug, cp.title AS title, cp.summary AS summary, cc.category_name AS category, cc.category_code AS categorySlug, su.nickname AS author, DATE_FORMAT(cp.published_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS publishedAt, cp.reading_minutes AS readingMinutes, IFNULL(cp.cover_url, '') AS coverUrl, cp.cover_tone AS coverTone, cp.is_featured AS featured, cp.ranking AS ranking, cp.view_count AS views, cp.like_count AS likes, cp.favorite_count AS favorites, IFNULL(col.title, '') AS `column`
FROM content_post cp LEFT JOIN content_category cc ON cc.id = cp.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = cp.author_id LEFT JOIN content_column col ON col.id = cp.column_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, IFNULL(username, '') AS level, IFNULL(signature, '') AS signature FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM content_favorite f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}) AS favorites, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM content_comment c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1) AS comments, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM content_view_history h WHERE h.user_id = #{userId}) AS history
